name: Temple of N'cthail
title: Temple of N'cthail
summary: The Temple of N'cthail rises from the sea west of Vissidal Island (part of Raising Grael's Island); inside are the portals to the Eastern, Western and Northern Temple Catacombs and the Vault of Eternal Slumber. The kit shows a cross-shaped complex ~170 m across standing in shallow sea: a 51 m central tower (0x010034C6) with four Statues of Transport on its terrace (z 36.6), four 37 m pitched-roof halls on its sides, three-storey colonnaded halls and red-roofed buildings (12.6-24.6 m) on the arms; the catacomb portals glow inside the halls at z 11.9 and the Temple Exit at the north end.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).

shots.standingOrder: Skim north-east 3.5 m above the sea toward the temple at 6.5 m/s along the line from (37405, 43530), stopping 38 m short of its south-west wing; open water only.
shots.notes: Water approach to the Temple of N'cthail, the drowned temple rising from the sea west of Vissidal: a cross-shaped complex of red-roofed halls (12-37 m) around a 51 m central tower crowned with Statues of Transport. The skim starts on open sea and runs at the temple, which spreads across the frame; noon sun from the right.
